When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}

4559-5147-7810-7839.description:

Smaug triggers, creating two artifact tokens due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two artifact tokens, returning Metalwork Colossus from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Repeat.

1833-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
1833-2438-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1987-3617-4423-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4423-7487.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2231-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2231-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

4136-5702-6441.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
4136-5702-6441.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Roaring Earth
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1692-2489-3732-5913.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{R}{R}.
1692-2489-3732-5913.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 1 or greater that can attack and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1692-2489-3732-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}{R}.
Cast Relentless Assault by paying {2}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Pinnacle Monk with haste.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Relentless Assault from your graveyard to your hand.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Nature's Will triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Move to your next main phase and repeat from step 1.

Gain life.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1887-5775-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-5775-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
1887-5775-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Avatar Kuruk, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At the end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Avatar Kuruk and causing Avatar Kuruk to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger and Fortune trigger.
Resolve the Fortune trigger, causing you to scry 2.
Resolve the Legend of Kuruk triggers, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.

3277-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
3277-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Izzet Chronarch and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Izzet Chronarch, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5402.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Pirate you control.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos.

228-1339-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature whose toughness is equal to one.
228-1339-4289.description:

The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Skullclamp triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate an Insect by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4891-5111-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Atsushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Atsushi dies, it and Mortuary trigger twice.
Resolve both Mortuary triggers, putting Atsushi on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the first Atsushi trigger, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the second Atsushi trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Atsushi from exile by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

221-1012-2393-3977-4818-5231.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Endurance and putting it onto the battlefield.
Endurance enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Endurance, adding {R}.
Endurance dies, triggering Sifter of Skulls, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the Endurance trigger from step 5, causing you to put all cards from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {R}.
Repeat.
